datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Chad to collect IPC classification data for different scenarios. Geographic boundaries were delineated and classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity, with data compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML formats for 2021.
